parties.respondent: India Ener Gen Private Limited & ANR

summary: Director liability under NI Act s.138/s.141; non-executive director without financial role; resignation prior to complaints; no specific averments of involvement; vicarious liability requires active responsibility at relevant time; High Court erred in dismissing quashing petitions; bald allegations insufficient for prosecution.
legal_provisions_cited: National Small Industries Corporation Limited v. Harmeet Singh Paintal and Another
S.M.S. Pharmaceuticals Ltd. v. Neeta Bhalla and Another
Pooja Ravinder Devidasani v. State of Maharashtra
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; criminal proceedings quashed against the appellant.
